leadText: Marimaru's Love Story (Japanese: マリ丸の恋物語 Love Story) is the sixtieth chapter of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga.
plainText:
Marimaru's Love Story (Japanese: マリ丸の恋物語 Love Story) is the sixtieth chapter of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga.

==Plot==
 
Marimaru's meeting some old friends of hers, and they all seem so proud of their boyfriends. Feeling a bit pressured, Marimaru convinces to pretend to be her beau.

==Important characters and Pokémon==
